description: This source file defines the ExceptionPatcher class, which processes call graphs to identify exception propagation sequences, fetches context, generates prompts for AI-based code fixes, and interacts with external systems like Redis, GitHub, and OpenAI to automate exception handling and code patching.

classes.name: ExceptionPatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for analyzing call graphs to identify exception propagation, generate context-aware prompts, and automate code fixes via AI and version control integrations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ExceptionPatcher with Redis client and repository URL, setting up helper instances.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method that builds call graphs from Redis, enriches them with GitHub context, identifies exception sequences, fetches context, generates prompts, and interacts with AI helpers to create code patches.

methods.name: extract_json_simple
methods.description: Extracts a JSON substring from a text response, used to parse AI-generated responses.

methods.name: build_graphs_from_redis
methods.description: Retrieves call graph data from Redis based on a pattern and constructs CallGraph objects.

methods.name: enrich_graphs_with_github_context
methods.description: Enriches each call graph with GitHub context information via the RepoHelper.

methods.name: select_exception_sequences
methods.description: Identifies sequences of nodes in the call graph involved in exception propagation, forming chains based on exception types.

methods.name: fetch_exception_context
methods.description: Gathers detailed context for exception nodes, including parent and child function details.

methods.name: format_node_details
methods.description: Formats detailed information about a node, including function name, file line, arguments, exceptions, return values, and code snippets.

methods.name: fetch_parents
methods.description: Recursively fetches parent nodes up to a specified depth, including code snippets.

methods.name: fetch_children
methods.description: Recursively fetches child nodes up to a specified depth, including code snippets.

methods.name: generate_fix_prompt_based_on_context
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for AI to suggest code fixes based on exception context, including function details, inputs, outputs, and implementation snippets.
